protectedAreas.status: Skuleberget endpoint enters or abuts Skuleberget nature reserve; High Coast world-heritage context applies throughout
protectedAreas.confidence: high for Skuleberget reserve endpoint context; exact rule application requires GIS overlay
notes: Skuleberget nature reserve: 224 ha, decisions 1969, 1974 and 2017, managed by Länsstyrelsen.
Skuleberget is not Skuleskogens nationalpark; national-park/Natura rules apply to later/continuing sections unless final geometry proves overlap.

skulebergetReserveRules.summary: Inside Skuleberget reserve: no tenting; fires only at designated fireplaces; dogs/loose pets must be leashed; do not damage trees, shrubs, ground, blocks, water environments, plants, fungi, mosses, lichens or invertebrates; no motor vehicles/cycling except allowed areas; no signs/marking/building structures; events need Länsstyrelsen permission.
caveats: Apply reserve rules only inside the reserve boundary after GIS overlay.

dogs.summary: Dogs/loose pets must be leashed in Skuleberget reserve. Rules lane also says avoid Grottstigen with dogs because metal steps can trap claws. No section-specific livestock restriction found.
dogs.confidence: high for reserve/dog note; medium for no livestock-specific note

closuresReroutes.summary: No active closure or current notice found on official Etapp 5, Naturkartan, or Länsstyrelsen Skuleberget pages as of 2026-04-29.
notes: Route segmentation and numbering have legacy conflicts.
Adjacent north-of-endpoint reports mention rerouting/new path toward Skuleskogen; do not attach those as a current section-5 closure without direct evidence.

seasonalAccess.summary: Naturum 2026 opening dates found: 2 Apr-21 Jun 10-16, 22 Jun-16 Aug 9-18, 17 Aug-4 Oct 10-16. Skuleberget winter hiking may require studs/traction or snowshoes; Naturum parking is plowed.

terrainSafety.summary: Official difficulty is hard. Skuleberget trails are demanding; Grottstigen is steep with rocks, steps and rails, should be avoided in wet weather and with small children, and is better uphill than downhill. Höga Kustenleden up Skuleberget is stony/undulating but less steep. Road-walk caution applies around Mäja-Docksta/Docksta/E4-adjacent areas.
terrainSafety.confidence: high for Skuleberget difficulty and Grottstigen caution; medium for road-walk exposure details

huntingForestry.summary: No active official hunting or forestry closure found for this section in the first pass. Respect temporary signs, forestry operations and hunting notices.

conditionReports.summary: Current first-person report. Notes new routing from Friluftsbyn over Skuleberget overlaps/merges with Höga Kustenstigen and caused some confusion; field markers generally led correctly but sparse signs caused occasional backtracking. Describes Docksta-Naturum via Skuleberget as harder than older descriptions, with a steep rocky/rooty north-side descent.
Useful for Ullånger, Gårdberget and Mäjasjön. Supports steep but short climb to Gårdberget/Äskjaberget and water/rest caveats around Mäjasjön.
Useful for old coastal road, water before Fäberget, Fäberget shelter/rest/camp and road/trail mix. Stops before Skuleberget.

Older numbering and likely pre-current Skuleberget routing; useful for rain, terrain and service context. Reports route generally separated enough from E4 except short stretches, which conflicts with some reports describing road/transport feel.
Older source, useful only as historical terrain/service signal because route segmentation has changed.
Still uses old Ullånger-Sköved split. Review text mostly unavailable; use only as aggregate/stale-stage evidence.
Still uses old split Sköved-Skuleberget. Aggregate says Hard, 12.4 km, 559 m gain, 4.5-5 h; useful for difficulty/elevation context but not current section identity.

sourceContradictions.details: Current official section is Etapp 5 Ullånger-Skuleberget, but Naturkartan URL still says old Ullånger-Sköved/etapp-6 and older apps/reports split the corridor as old Etapp 6 Ullånger-Sköved plus old Etapp 7 Sköved-Skuleberget.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use current Etapp 5 identity; preserve old split labels as aliases/search metadata only.

sourceContradictions.details: Höga Kusten GPX is official and has elevation, but retains old two-track split with a 72.6 m gap and localized deviations. Naturkartan GPX/API is continuous and agrees closely with current OSM.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use Naturkartan GPX/API as primary current geometry. Keep Höga Kusten GPX as alternate/elevation reference.

sourceContradictions.details: Official distance is 20.8 km. Naturkartan GPX/API compute about 20.46 km; OSM/Waymarked about 20.4 km; Höga Kusten GPX computes 20.819 km.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use official 20.8 km for displayed section distance, with computed geometry metrics recorded.

sourceContradictions.details: A 2024 field report says current routing goes over/overlaps Skuleberget and Höga Kustenstigen; older Komoot/field tips said Skuleberget/Höga Kustenstigen were not part of Höga Kustenleden.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Treat older exclusion claims as stale. Use current official/Naturkartan/OSM geometry.

sourceContradictions.details: Section is named to Skuleberget, but GPX endpoint is at Naturum Höga Kusten/eastern foot, not the summit.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use endpoint label Skuleberget / Naturum Höga Kusten.

sourceContradictions.details: Official/facility sources list water at Mäjasjön in summer and business/service taps, while field reports and rules lane emphasize water logistics and seasonal unreliability.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Model business taps as opening-dependent, Mäjasjön as summer/uncertain, Gårdberget and Fäberget as no-water, and natural water as filter/boil required.

sourceContradictions.topic: Skuleberget rules versus national park rules
sourceContradictions.details: Skuleberget endpoint is a nature reserve with local rules; it is not Skuleskogens nationalpark, which applies to later/continuing sections.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Import Skuleberget reserve rules for reserve area only after geometry overlay; do not attach Skuleskogen national-park rules to section 5 unless later geometry proves overlap.
